judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: Thumbnail photo (a 2025 Lexus UX 300h, a hybrid) inside the 'Browse New Cars' tile link whose visible text is 'Hybrid'. The photo is there to stand for the category the link opens, and the alt 'Hybrids' says that, which is an equivalent purpose for an image in a link. No photo can show a drivetrain, so asking the alt to describe only what is visible is stricter than 1.1.1. At most the alt repeats the link text, which is advisory, not a failure.

judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: Top navigation 'Save Money & Fuel' is a Bootstrap dropdown toggle (href javascript:void(0), data-toggle=dropdown). It opens the 'Save Money & Fuel' submenu, and the submenu items (Gas Mileage Tips, Tax Incentives, Gasoline Prices, Cost Calculators) sit in the same list item, so its purpose is clear from its text and its menu context, which the model was given. It is a section menu trigger, not a vague link. Any problem with it being a link rather than a button with expanded state is a 4.1.2 matter, not 2.4.4.

judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: Header mini-menu link 'Español' to /feg/esIndex.shtml. The live HTML still has Español, with no lang on the link or on its li/ul/nav ancestors, and the page is html lang="en". A language name written in that language is not a proper name or English vernacular. The 3.1.2 Understanding document's examples (alternative language links, and the 'Español' span example) say such links need lang. I found no technique that makes it pass.

judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: Thumbnail of a 2017 Honda Clarity Fuel Cell (the file is named so) in the 'Fuel Cell' tile link. judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: is an empty in-page target for the skip link. It has no href and no tabindex, so it is not focusable (the snapshot's 'focusable' state is not backed by the CDP data), and it has no content and no bounds. Chrome reports role link for it probably only because page scripts (federated analytics or similar) attach click listeners to anchors. Under HTML-AAM an anchor without href is generic, and users never perceive it as a control, so it is not a user interface component under 4.1.2. ACT's link-name rule and axe both leave out href-less anchors like this.

judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: Year select #mnuYear1 under 'Browse by Model', labelled with a real <label for> 'From:'. It is paired with 'To: (optional)', and its options are model years 2027 to 1984. On screen it reads 'From: 2026', and a screen reader announces 'From:, combo box, 2026'. Nothing has to be typed in. The label and its control together give an appropriate cue for a model-year range, and 2.4.6 lets labels be short. 'Model year from' would be clearer, but the label is accurate, not undescriptive.
